text:
jess: Quick heads-up — our 'Webinar: Production Inference' registration conversion dropped ~30% yesterday per the weekly KPI dashboard. GA4 sessions flat, HubSpot new contacts down. Any thoughts?
omar: I saw a spike in 500s on /register around 15:12 UTC. digging logs now.
maya: dashboard link: https://app.redwood/marketing/webinar-funnel — conversion curve dips after 2026-03-18.
liam: possible UTM inconsistency across creatives? some use `utm_campaign=prod_launch` vs `prod-launch`. that fragments attribution.
anne: I deployed a small redirect to /webinars/production on 2026-03-18 15:00 — could be stripping referrer or params. @deploy-bot can you confirm deploy window?
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T15:00 by anne — service: web-redirects v4.0 — no rollback.
omar: logs peek: ```POST /api/register 500 {"error":"timeout writing to redis"}``` ~120 occurrences between 15:10-15:20 UTC.
jess: 120 failed submits is significant — how many HubSpot creates did we lose?
maya: HubSpot new contacts delta = -240 vs baseline. GA4 filtered sessions delta = -60 (there was an internal filter change on 2026-03-18).
liam: normalizing the UTM variants looks like it would recover ~+170 leads (prelim estimate).
omar: redis timeouts point to reg-worker connection pool exhaustion. opening infra ticket and will tally failed submits for reconciliation.
anne: redirect change likely dropped campaign params for some user agents. I'm adding a preserve-utm flag and will push a tiny follow-up.
jess: proposed action items: 1) liam — normalize UTMs in ETL and backfill mappings; 2) maya — produce GA4 vs HubSpot crosswalk for last 14 days; 3) omar — confirm reg-service fix, tally failed registers; 4) anne — postmortem & rollback checklist; 5) jess — add dashboard alert for sudden attribution drops.
maya: will build a quick viz comparing GA4 session->event -> HS creates and drop CSV in #marketing after this thread.
liam: pushed normalize-utms card to backlog (priority: P0). quick script shows +170 matched conversions.
omar: infra ticket created: INF-2987. mitigation in progress, ETA ~2h for full remediation.
jess: combined estimated uplift ~230 which aligns with the -240 delta. good detective work.
anne: i'll draft a short postmortem and add to the marketing postmortems board.
maya: thanks team :raised_hands: will share artifacts shortly.
jess: reconvene if anything changes; closing thread.
